notes.title: It's over!
notes.content:
Hi friends,
Today I want to say goodbye to you and my team! I, the main developer of Eyes of Destiny and the leader of the whole team, announce that I'm leaving!

I am completely ending my participation in the team. This decision was not easy for me. 

During the short time we've been working on the project, we've come a long way, filled with challenges, discoveries and, most importantly, true unity. I am grateful to everyone who was there for us and just those who believed in us.

Your support inspired me to move forward even when my strength seemed to be running out. My journey ends here. 


Thank you for everything! 


I also want to let you know that Eyes of Destiny will continue to be developed without me. If the team doesn't continue to release updates and work on the game, it will be completely free forever!!! 

May Eyes of Destiny continue to live, change, and inspire new heroes. 



See you soon and all the best to you, my dear friends!

Best regards,

Valery Raubishko







If there are any questions or if you have any problems, please join our official server for help.
